question: Can an online within-hour confidence-and-lifecycle selective admission mechanism raise initial direction precision toward >=80% while preserving >=90% of every R9 SYNTH matching UTC hour and day?
authorized: Only original pinned eight Coinexx/Dukascopy native tick quote months; features/research caches from R00-067/068/069/070/072/073. Unchanged readers and clock registry.
direction: Use protected R00-068 baseline BUY/SELL; optionally require three independent 073 predictor sign agreement without changing side. No labels as input. Experts operate individually and fall back to baseline when not ready.
selection: Online only. Each UTC hour a causal paced admission quota Q with schedule from elapsed wall second, confidence thresholds defined ex ante, catchup rule, and no reference to future per-hour event counts or future directions. No retrospective top-k.
policy_family: No gate control plus budgets Q=130,150,180,240 and confidence base abs score >0.04,0.06,0.08,0.10; residual posterior >.65/.70; consensus and lifecycle-gated variants. Freeze highest February directional accuracy among policies retaining >=20% of original Feb candidate events and >=95% of nonempty Feb hours with >=100 emitted candidate events, else fallback ungated baseline.
source_splits: January fitting only for 073 model; February 074 policy choice; June/July historically exposed transfer only; no blind claim.
metrics: Selected accuracy, original event counts, BUY/SELL, neutral/missing wrong, every R9 SYNTH UTC hour/day/week/month denominator and coverage; never alter R9 historic trade metric meaning.
stop_rule: If selective admission cannot exceed existing directional performance at all-hour 90% R9 floor, save outcome and develop genuinely new bid/ask sequence and event-time hazard/oracle instead of microoptimizing thresholds.
no_economics: No exit, profit, fills, or investor release claims.
